page.overview:
Who is Chimaera?

The Chimaera is a monster in Greek mythology, a fire breathing creature that merges elements of three different animals (which depending on the version is lion/snake/goat or lion/dragon/goat).

The Chimaera is a descendant of the Elder God Set. It's the offspring of Set's granddaughter Echidna who mated with Typhon, one of the Titans.

Chimaera is introduced as a creature species in the 7th Edition. (: Cthulhu Invictus)
